description:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

More about our team and company:

  • Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg
  • Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers

We're looking for an evidence-based, customer-centric, and inventive Staff Product Manager to build Parts into a product line and a revenue stream at Fleetio. Parts are one of the largest and least managed line items in fleet maintenance: technicians call counters, re-key quotes, chase cores and returns, and reconcile invoices by hand. Fleetio already sees the work order, the asset, the VIN and the repair history, so we're positioned to know what part a repair needs before anyone picks up the phone.

As Staff Product Manager, Parts, you'll own Parts at Fleetio end to end. It starts with the vision for how fleets manage and order parts, and the roadmap to get there. From there, you'll build an AI-powered parts ordering product from the ground up, connect Fleetio to the suppliers fleets already buy from, and work with our Payments team to stand up the payments and settlement behind every order. The goal: a fleet tells Fleetio what's broken, and Fleetio finds, orders, pays for and reconciles the right parts, whether the repair happens in the fleet's own shop or a network shop.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Product Management for the Maintenance Division, you'll partner with a cross-functional team of engineering, design, data, and go-to-market, and work closely with our Maintenance Shop Network (MSN, our outsourced maintenance business unit), Payments, and in-house Maintenance teams. This is a 0-to-1 role inside a scaled SaaS company: you'll define the ordering product, not inherit one, with real customers and data on day one and a new business model to build on top.

Who You Are

Our ideal candidate for this role is insatiably curious and commercially minded, and has taken a product from a blank page to revenue. You're as comfortable in a shop with technicians and parts managers as you are working through an API spec with a supplier or a settlement model with Finance. You make high-quality decisions under uncertainty: you state your hypotheses, look for evidence before you commit, and kill or pivot weak ideas quickly. You have strong, loosely held opinions, write clearly, and create clarity and momentum for the people you work with. You lead and align through influence, not authority. You're fluent with AI tools, and realistic about what it takes for a customer to trust AI with their money.

Your Impact

  • Set the vision for parts management and ordering at Fleetio, and turn it into a strategy and roadmap, including build/partner/integrate calls for each supplier and channel.
  • Own the parts and inventory tools fleets already use in Fleetio, and make them the foundation the ordering product builds on.
  • Build the AI parts ordering product from the ground up: problem framing, discovery with technicians and parts managers, prototypes, evals, human-in-the-loop controls, approval rules, and the trust model fleets need before AI spends their money.
  • Own supplier integrations at the product level: scope, API requirements, commercial input, joint roadmaps, and which parts houses we integrate with next.
  • Build and own strategic supplier relationships, and serve as a credible product leader in front of parts partners.
  • Design the payments and settlement model in collaboration with our Payments team, Finance and Legal: settlement timing, pricing, rebates, credit, tax, returns and cores, and reconciliation back to the work order.
  • Partner with MSN, Payments, and in-house Maintenance teams so parts work the same in a fleet's own shop or a network shop.
  • Talk to fleets, technicians and parts managers every week, and turn what you learn into hypotheses you can test in weeks, not quarters.
  • Understand the parts market in depth (suppliers, catalogs, aggregators and ordering tools), and use it to shape Fleetio's positioning and product line strategy.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with research, design, engineering, data science, marketing, and customer-facing teams, giving them clear problems, goals and boundaries to build against.
  • Own the business case (GMV, attach rate, margin) and report it to product and executive leadership.
  • Effectively communicate product vision, value proposition, trade-offs, risks, learnings, and roadmap updates to stakeholders, executives, customers, and supplier partners.
  • Guide parts features through their entire creative cycle: discovery, ideation, specification, test, delivery, launch / GTM, analysis, and optimization.
  • Raise the bar for product quality based on strong evidence.

Your First Year

  • First 90 days: you know the parts workflow cold from time with technicians and parts managers, you've published a Parts vision, strategy and roadmap, and a working prototype of the AI parts ordering product is in front of design-partner fleets.
  • First 12 months: the AI parts ordering product, supplier integrations and payments are in production with customers and reported as a measurable revenue line.

Your Experience

  • 7+ years of product management, including setting a product vision and building at least one product from zero to revenue.
  • A track record of leading ambiguous 0-to-1 bets with meaningful company impact, operating with high autonomy.
  • Deep experience in at least one:
  • Partner API integrations (auth, catalogs, orders, webhooks), including managing the partner relationship
  • AI/LLM features in production, with evals and clear rules for when a human must approve
  • Parts ordering or parts management, or an adjacent fleet-related area
  • Comfortable owning a P&L-style business case and defending it to executives.
  • Strong written communication; you write the strategy doc, not just the tickets.
  • BA/BS/MS in Computer Science, Business, Design, or related equivalent field/experience.
  • A proven track record of strong cross-functional collaboration.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data and insights into actionable product strategies and decisions.
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI tools and concepts.
  • An entrepreneurial spirit: you are self-driven, accountable, and comfortable presenting to customers, prospects, partners, and stakeholders.
  • Natural leadership skills: you influence and inspire others who love working with you.
  • Champion our core values of intelligence, intensity, integrity, and ownership.

Considered a plus

  • Experience in more than one of the following: partner API integrations, AI/LLM features in production, and parts ordering or parts management.
  • Automotive aftermarket, parts distribution, fleet or dealer experience (parts catalogs, ACES/PIES, VIN decoding, cores, warranty).
  • B2B marketplaces, group purchasing or rebate programs.
  • Procurement/AP automation, card issuing or embedded payments.
  • Experience at a parts supplier, catalog aggregator or shop-management software company.

Benefits 

  • Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
  • Vision insurance
  • Incentive stock options
  • 401(k) match of 4%
  • PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!)
  • 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays
  • Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid)
  • FSA & HSA options
  • Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid)
  • Community service funds
  • Professional development funds
  • Wellbeing fund - $150 quarterly
  • Business expense stipend - $125 quarterly
  • Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend
  • Fully stocked kitchen with tons of drinks & snacks (BHM only)
  • Remote working friendly since 2012 #LI-Remote

Fleetio provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need.

This application is not intended to and does not create a contract or offer of employment. Employment with Fleetio is at will.

If you have a disability or a special need that requires an accommodation to fill out the online application, please let us know by calling (205) 718-7500.
